description: UN-Water produced the SDG 6 Data Portal, which brings together the UN's water and sanitation data for the 11 global SDG 6 indicators, among them safely managed drinking water (6.1.1), sanitation (6.2.1), safely treated domestic wastewater (6.3.1), water-use efficiency (6.4.1), water stress (6.4.2) and water resources management (6.5.1). Coverage is all countries, regions and the world. The data are free to view and explore online. Caveats: estimates are compiled from country data by the custodian UN agencies and are sometimes complemented from other sources, and indicator years differ. Simulation uses: country baselines of service coverage, wastewater treatment and water stress for planning and adaptation studies. Related records: the WHO/UNICEF JMP WASH database (data-who-unicef-jmp-wash-database).
